thread:
Asha: quick sync: we've hit inconsistencies when a hosted pin falls back to dedicated and the runtime picks a different quant variant. Does anyone want to propose a minimal contract to avoid churn?
Brett: tl;dr: separate intent (what user asked) from enforcement (what runtime must keep). control plane should own intent, runtimes hold short-lived signed leases to enforce.
Lin: agree but private installs are offline. leases must be exportable and customer-signable so private runtimes can operate without control plane access.
Asha: minimal lease fields: lease_id, model_id, model_hash, mem_est_mb, issuer, issued_at, expires_at, signature. keep it compact.
Brett: mechanics: POST /v1/intents creates intent and returns lease for online modes. for private, provide intent-bundle export endpoint.
Lin: revocation: short TTL + revocation list (pulled intermittently) is simplest. runtime treats local customer-signed overrides as higher precedence for private installs.
Asha: operational defaults: TTL 15m, renew every 5m. make TTL configurable per tenant.
Brett: telemetry: emit lease_issued, lease_renew, lease_revoked, enforcement_decision events with lease_id and reason. include selected_variant and selection_reason.
Lin: security: ed25519 signatures, issuer_kid in header. private installs can use customer KMS to sign local leases; control plane validates public keys on initial install.
Asha: action items: Brett write compact spec for lease proto, Lin prototype verify library in go-runtime, I'll file RFC and coordinate with docs.
ops-bot: deploy: leases-svc v1.3 rolled out to hosted. No downtime.
Brett: thanks bot. I'll post RFC link once drafted. Asha: thanks all.
